category_title: Active and vocal students during teacher-led instruction
minimal_context: The student is working on a computer using the Novanet online instructional program for self-paced learning.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please get on your computers and start your self-paced learning on the Novanet program.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Do we have to use Novanet? I strongly feel that this program is boring.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just log in and start working on your assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just clicking through it. I do not seem to learn from the online lessons at all.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying, you need to finish the module today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing this anymore. I'm completely discontent with this Novanet program, it's entirely boring and I refuse to use it!
